title: I should have thought out the size a little more.
text: I should have thought out the size a little more.. I use my other one, that it was replacing, to cut up salads and other veggies on. This was a lot smaller than I thought it would be.

product_metadata.title: Dexas Chop & Scoop Cutting Board, Small 6.5 by 10.5 inches, White with Black Handle
features: Funnel shape with curved edges perfect for cutting juicy fruits and vegetables
Non-slip feet so cutting board will not move during use
description: The Dexas Chop and Scoop board features an innovative design ideal for cutting juicy fruits and vegetables. The curved edges keep juices contained and the unique shape and grip handle makes it easy to chop, lift and scoop foods into pans and bowls. Made of 100-percent virgin polypropylene which will not dull your knives, and is non-stick, non-absorbent, non-porous and odor resistant. Dishwasher safe. Dexas Chop and Scoop Boards are made in the USA.
